theorem.name: HiggsProjectionNoExtraBoundarySourceTheorem
theorem.statement: The premise-free Phi_fin restriction morphism proves that the physical source restricts to the selected finite quotient with no extra physical boundary/source term. The Higgs projection morphism P_q is an internal finite algebraic idempotent built from the selected quotient and metric, so restricting the finite trace to im(P_q) adds no new continuum boundary and no external source term.
